Over 2 crore Indians invest with Zerodha. Opening a demat account is free.
In this conversation, Prateek and Karthik look back at 15+ years of investing and talk about the mistakes they made, the lessons they learned, and how their thinking evolved over time.
From chasing returns to understanding risk, this is an honest conversation about what worked, what didn't, and what they wish they had known earlier.
Hopefully, hearing about their experiences helps you avoid a few mistakes of your own, while making some of your own along the way :)
